description: Hi! We’re team Capella. The brightest star.
summary:
HotSync is a free web platform that makes NASA MODIS and VIIRS fire data comparable across time. It helps users explore fire activity from 2001 onward through interactive maps, monthly calendars, and charts for countries or custom areas.

We clean NASA FIRMS data, remove unreliable detections and persistent industrial heat sources, and calculate monthly conversion factors using years when both sensors operated. These factors adjust older MODIS counts to a VIIRS-like scale, helping users distinguish fire trends from differences between sensors.

Our goal is to make long-term fire information accessible to researchers, fire managers, students, and the public. Users can compare trends, view recent detections, and download results.

We built the frontend with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, using Leaflet for maps and Chart.js for charts. Python, pandas, and NumPy handle data processing, while GitHub Actions automates updates and GitHub Pages hosts the website.
